list.label: 자동 추가 필드
list.query:
import "influxdata/influxdb/schema"
schema.fieldKeys(bucket: "sensors", predicate: (r) => r._measurement == "mqtt" and r.cube == "${cube}" and r.kind == "data", start: -30d)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => not contains(value: r._value, set: ["ads1115_ok", "applied_seq", "chip_temp", "fan1", "fan1_rpm", "fan2", "fan2_rpm", "humidity", "lease_active", "led1", "led2", "led_mode", "lux", "moisture_calibrated", "moisture_pct", "moisture_raw", "moisture_v", "motor_duty", "motor_set", "pump", "pump_locked", "rssi_dbm", "temperature", "uptime_ms"]))

  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
